#include <string>

    std::string token;
    while (std::getline(std::cin, token)) {
        if (!token.empty()) break;
    }
    
    char prev = '#';
    int cnt = 1;
    int ans = 0;
    for (char cur : token) {
        if (cur == prev) {
            cnt++;
        } else {
            if (cnt % 2 == 0) {
                ans++;
            }
            cnt = 1;
        }
        prev = cur;
    }
    if (cnt % 2 == 0) {
        ans++;
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
